notes.title: Discolored 2 Release Date!
notes.notes:
📢 Announcement time! 📢 

Discolored 2 will release on January 8th 2025 on Steam!

The game will also be playable on the Steam Deck. If you haven't already wishlisted the game please consider doing do. The Steam algorithm favors games with a high wishlist count.

Happy holidays to you and yours! See you in January!🎄 🥂 ❤️‍💚💙

notes.title: Update to fix cursor and input issues some players were having
notes.notes: A patch was just released updating the Unity engine version along with some plugins to address cursor and input issues reported by some players.

notes.title: Minor bug fix for high end monitors
notes.notes:
Discolored has been updated with a fix for those playing with a high-end monitor and were experiencing stuttering issues while looking up and down. This should be vastly improved if not completely fixed. For best results please make sure Vsync is enabled. You may have to restart Steam to get the update. If anyone runs into any issues with this update please let me know.

Thanks!
Jason

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just a quick update to let you know the game has now been patched fixing most of the bugs. 

Some people had an issue with their cursor getting stuck while in the suitcase view, this was addressed a day or so after the game's launch. If you are running into this please make sure you have the latest version and there is no update pending for the game.

There was also an issue with things looking like they were stuttering while moving when running on a high end PC. Note that this wasn't due to low framerate, but rather something out of sync with the way things were setup in the Unity game engine. This has just recently been addressed and should be good to go.

If you run into anything else please let me know.

Thanks!
Jason
